title: RHEL Patching with Pre/Post Checks and Service Continuity
description: Pre‑check memory and disk, snapshot running services, update all packages, reboot, post‑check memory, disk and service consistency, then emit a human‑readable summary report.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP of the RHEL server to patch.

parameters.name: min_free_memory_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free memory required before and after patching.

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free disk space per eligible filesystem.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma‑separated mount points to exclude from disk checks.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma‑separated filesystem types to exclude from disk checks.

parameters.name: package_name
parameters.description: Package(s) to update; use '*' for all (default).

steps.name: Get available free memory before update
steps.function: Retrieve available free memory in MB using the free command.

steps.name: Parse free memory to MB integer
steps.function: Convert raw shell output to an integer representing free memory in MB.

steps.name: Check pre‑update free memory
steps.function: Determine if the available memory is below the configured minimum threshold.
steps.condition: Pre‑update free memory (MB) is below the minimum free memory threshold (GB).

steps.name: Gather mount information before update
steps.function: Retrieve filesystem mount points, types, and available sizes using setup.

steps.name: Identify mounts with insufficient disk space (pre‑update)
steps.function: Filter out excluded mounts and types, then check available space against the threshold, building a list of problematic mount points and a pass/fail flag.

computations._disk_issues_pre: List of mount points that fail the space check after applying fs_exclude_list and fs_type_exclude_list.
computations._disk_pre_pass: True if _disk_issues_pre is empty, else False.

steps.name: Check pre‑update disk space
steps.function: Branch if any examined mount point lacks sufficient free disk space.
steps.condition: At least one mount point has insufficient free disk space (pre‑update check).

steps.name: Gather running service facts (pre‑update)
steps.function: Collect systemd service facts to obtain the current state of all services.

steps.name: Extract running service names (pre‑update)
steps.function: Filter the pre‑update service facts to a list of service names that are in the running state.

computations._pre_services: List of service names with state 'running'.

steps.name: Update all packages
steps.function: Upgrade every installed package to the latest available version.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the machine and wait for it to become reachable again.

steps.name: Get available free memory after update
steps.function: Retrieve available free memory in MB after the reboot.

steps.name: Parse post‑update free memory to MB
steps.function: Convert raw post‑update shell output to an integer MB value.

steps.name: Determine if post‑update memory passes the threshold
steps.function: Compute a boolean flag indicating whether post‑reboot free memory meets the required minimum.

steps.name: Gather mount information after update
steps.function: Retrieve filesystem mount points, types, and available sizes after the reboot.

steps.name: Identify mounts with insufficient disk space (post‑update)
steps.function: Re‑apply the exclusion and threshold logic against post‑reboot mounts, recording problematic mount points and a pass/fail flag.

computations._disk_issues_post: List of mount points that fail the space check after applying fs_exclude_list and fs_type_exclude_list.
computations._post_disk_pass: True if _disk_issues_post is empty, else False.

steps.name: Gather running service facts (post‑update)
steps.function: Collect systemd service facts after the reboot.

steps.name: Extract running service names (post‑update)
steps.function: Filter the post‑reboot service facts to a list of running service names.

computations._post_services: List of service names with state 'running'.

steps.name: Compare pre‑ and post‑update service lists
steps.function: Compare the two sets of running service names, record any mismatches and a pass/fail flag.

computations._services_mismatch_list: List of service names present in one snapshot but not the other (symmetric difference).
computations._services_pass: True if _services_mismatch_list is empty, else False.

steps.name: Build final human‑readable report
steps.function: Assemble a multi‑line report string that includes pre/post memory results, disk issue lists, service mismatch details, and the update/reboot status.

computations._report: Construct a human‑readable summary: Pre‑update free memory check (pass/fail), Pre‑update disk check (pass/fail with list of failed mounts if any), Post‑update free memory check (pass/fail), Post‑update disk check (pass/fail with list), Pre‑update running services count, Post‑update running services count, Service mismatch (pass/fail with list if mismatch), Update status: success, Reboot status: success.

steps.name: Print report and end
steps.function: Output the final report string in the <result> block.

steps.name: Print error and fail
steps.function: Reached on pre‑check failure or any runtime error. Prints an error message and stops the play.
steps.error_message: Patching pre‑check failed or runtime error. Aborting.

phases.name: Pre‑update checks
phases.description: Validate available memory and disk space before patching; abort if thresholds are not met.

phases.name: Pre‑update service snapshot
phases.description: Record the list of running services before making changes.

phases.name: Update and reboot
phases.description: Upgrade all packages and reboot the server.

phases.name: Post‑update checks
phases.description: Verify memory, disk space and service continuity after the reboot.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Assemble and emit the human‑readable summary report.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Terminal step reached on pre‑check failure or any runtime error.
